events.what_it_is: A two-day public fragrance pop-up for Estée Lauder's new Glimmer Eau de Parfum, with fragrance discovery and photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Admission is free. Current event listings advertise a chance to receive complimentary Estée Lauder product; promotional product is not guaranteed to every visitor.
events.caveats: Current NYC event listings independently identify the pop-up as open to the public. No advance RSVP or organizer-approval requirement is published. Complimentary product is chance- or inventory-dependent rather than guaranteed.
events.practical_notes: Friday, September 11 from 12:30–7 PM and Saturday, September 12 from 11 AM–7 PM at 711 Greenwich Street.

events.event_name: Scoop the City Ice Cream Truck Tour
events.address: Mobile truck; see each dated occurrence for stops
events.what_it_is: A two-day mobile ice cream truck tour highlighting StreetEasy and Piece of Cake Moving's 2026 neighborhood hot list, with free ice cream and prize-entry opportunities.
events.what_is_free: A complimentary ice cream treat is advertised at the truck stops. Visitors can also enter to win Knicks tickets, restaurant gift cards, MTA passes, merchandise and other prizes; sweepstakes prizes are not guaranteed.
events.caveats: The truck is mobile and only stays at each listed stop for a limited window. Free treats and promotional inventory can run out. Current sources describe the tour as open to the public with no RSVP requirement.
events.practical_notes: September 12 and 13 from 11 AM–6 PM overall, with multiple short neighborhood stops each day. Use the date-specific details for the route.

events.what_it_is: A three-day immersive shopping and beauty pop-up centered on Gucci Westman's lifestyle essentials and Suprême Bio-Complex Liquid Foundation, with shade matching and scheduled community programming.
events.what_is_free: Public access to the pop-up and beauty discovery experience is advertised. Specific scheduled moments include GRWM, Shade Match & Spritz, and a Good Foundations Walk Club; merchandise purchases are optional.
events.caveats: Current NYC event listings describe the main pop-up as open to the public, while RSVPs are promoted for specific programmed moments. No organizer-approval language is established. A stable direct RSVP URL for the individual sessions was not surfaced in this verification pass.
events.practical_notes: September 11–13, 11 AM–6 PM at 251 Elizabeth Street. Program highlights: GRWM September 11 from 4–6 PM; Shade Match & Spritz September 12 from 4–6 PM; Walk Club September 13 from 10 AM–12 PM.
